QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] Why Would You Bring That?!
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Rave at the #bLuxury Tour Agency#k to ask what to do now.
QuestInfo.1: Rave smiled and wrapped it all up. Talk to Rave at the #bLuxury Tour Agency#k again.
QuestInfo.2: All's well that ends well. As a reward, you received a Detective Rave's Honorary Assistant Medal. Pretty amazing all this happened because of a random flyer...
